postconditions.description: The return value is a string.
The return value is a subsequence of at least one of the input sequences.

postconditions.expression: return_value in (seq1 and seq2 for seq1, seq2 in itertools.product([seq1], [seq2]))
postconditions.description: The return value is a subsequence of both input sequences.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(subseq) for subseq in (seq1 and seq2 for seq1, seq2 in itertools.product([seq1], [seq2])))
postconditions.description: The return value is the longest common subsequence of the input sequences.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' if not any(subseq in seq1 and subseq in seq2 for subseq in (seq1 and seq2 for seq1, seq2 in itertools.product([seq1], [seq2]))) else return_value
postconditions.description: The return value is an empty string if there is no common subsequence.
